loop.text: Name the player experience or risk this work is about.
Write the hypothesis, a measurable prediction and a kill/revert rule before any result exists. Commit them first.
Make the smallest change that can test the prediction. Experiment code is disposable.
Run the method at the rung the claim needs. Record build hash, seeds, bot policy and artifacts.
Keep, revise, remove, inconclusive or investigate. Record the decision and what was not shown.

ladder.name: Correctness
ladder.text: Unit tests, digests, validators. Proves the code does what it says, not that it is good.

ladder.name: One bot
ladder.text: Seeded simulation with one bot policy. Proves a measurable property under that policy.

ladder.name: Bot personas
ladder.text: Several bot personas (for example cautious, greedy, random) over many seeds. Proves the property is robust to play style.

ladder.name: Recorded play
ladder.text: The owner's recorded play with telemetry. Shows what a human actually did.

ladder.name: Owner judgment
ladder.text: The owner's judgment against a goal written down before the playtest. The only rung for fun, feel and look.

ladder_rules: A result never claims a higher rung than it reached.
Every result names its rung, bot policy, seed count and build hash.
Claims about fun, feel, clarity or look need E3 or E4. Request a playtest; do not infer them from bots.

card.label: Question
card.help: What do we want to learn?

card.label: Experience goal
card.help: What should the player feel or do?

card.label: Hypothesis
card.help: If we change X, then Y, because Z.

card.label: Prediction
card.help: A measurable number or observable event, with the threshold. Committed before the run; its author does not edit it afterwards.

card.label: Kill/revert rule
card.help: The result that makes us remove or revert the change.

card.label: Method and rung
card.help: How it is measured, and the rung (E0-E4) the claim needs.

card.label: Result
card.help: Filled after the run: numbers, artifacts, build hash.

card.label: Reached / not shown
card.help: Filled after the run: the rung reached and what this does not show.

card.label: Decision
card.help: Filled after the run: keep, revise, remove, inconclusive or investigate.

card_rules: The prediction is committed before results exist. Its author may not edit it afterwards; a correction is a new comment.
The checking agent confirms the prediction predates the results (issue edit history or commit order).

playtest_request.label: Build
playtest_request.help: Build or package path and commit hash.

playtest_request.label: Questions (1-2, observable)
playtest_request.help: What we watch for, not what we ask.

playtest_request.label: Task and length
playtest_request.help: What to play and for how long.

playtest_request.label: What you already know
playtest_request.help: Anything that spoils the test; keep it short.

playtest_request.label: Auto-recorded
playtest_request.help: Telemetry and captures collected without your help.

playtest_request.label: Decision rule
playtest_request.help: Written before the playtest: what result means keep, revise or remove.

playtest_request.label: Results
playtest_request.help: Filled after the playtest, as a comment.

experiment.title: Experiment
experiment.use: Testing a hypothesis about play. Code is disposable.
experiment.gate: A linked card with the prediction committed first, plus evidence at the card's rung.

tuning.title: Tuning
tuning.gate: An E1 or E2 improvement against the prior numbers.

content.title: Content / presentation
content.use: Art, UI, audio, VFX and copy.
content.gate: Fits the art kit, a walkthrough of every state, and owner judgment (E4) for look claims.

feature.title: Code feature
feature.use: New or changed behavior that ships.
feature.gate: Tests that fail without the change (E0), a performance check where relevant, docs updated; E3 or E4 for feel claims.

fix.title: Fix
fix.gate: A regression test that fails before the fix.

infra.title: Infrastructure
infra.use: Tools, CI, docs and process that do not change the game.

pr_checklist: Class line set, and the gate for that class is met.
Evidence lines point at files in this PR or links, not at descriptions.
The rung claimed is the rung reached; limits are under "Reached / not shown".
Another agent (or a fresh verifier) checked the work.
